newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCKS LOSE SOME GROUND, OLAINFARM PLUMMETS.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS LOSE SOME GROUND, OLAINFARM PLUMMETS.

text.p: Latvian stocks saw a slow session and Olainfarm jigsawed down amid speculative trading on Monday, dealers said.
The market is now looking to July, when six-month results will be released.
Total turnover came to 61,000 lats from Friday's 83,221 lats. The bourse index closed 0.41 points or 0.11 percent up at 383.62.
The Rietumu index slipped 0.59 pct to 152.63 amid trade which saw blue chips stable to lower.

"The general stagnation can turn into more activity later in the month as six-month results start appearing and for many bigger stocks expectations are pretty upbeat," Karlis Krastinsh, head of the securities department with the Saules Bank, told Reuters.
Official list's Unibanka added three santimes to 3.38 lats in trade of 20,700 lats. It was the session's most active stock.
Olainfarm pharmaceutical company, on the secondary list, plummeted to 2.17 lats from 2.55 lats, turning over 4,800 lats.
"The fall of the Olainfarm today or gains of the Liepaja Edible Oil factory depict speculative trading rather than the real value of the companies," Krastinsh said.
Liepaja, a recent bourse newcomer, jumped to 0.85 santimes from 0.74 santimes in small trade of 600 lats.
Elsewhere on the official list, Staburadze confectionary kept edging up, closing one santime up to 2.72 lats as it saw volume of 3,800 lats.
Riga Shipyard and the Riga Transport Fleet lost some ground and Shipyard registered trade of 9,000 lats as it lost two santimes to 1.30 lats.
Fleet closed two santimes lower at 1.15 lats on volume of 3,600 lats and the Kaija cannery remained stable at 2.18 lats, trading 2,900 lats.
On the secondary list, the Mangali Shipyard was up to 1.15 lats from 1.08 lats, registering activity of 5,800 lats.
